title: LaunchDarkly's approach to AI-powered product management
summary: A conversation with Claire Vo, Chief Product Officer of LaunchDarkly, about the changing role of product managers, her anti-to-do list, and building AI-native teams.
body: A conversation with Claire Vo, Chief Product Officer of LaunchDarkly, about the changing role of product managers, her anti-to-do list, and building AI-native teams.
summaryZh: 该文章记录了与LaunchDarkly首席产品官Claire Vo的对话，探讨了AI时代产品经理角色的转变、反待办事项列表（anti-to-do list）的概念以及如何构建AI原生团队。内容涉及企业内部拥抱AI转型的组织架构与管理方法。

aiReview.reasonZh: LaunchDarkly首席产品官分享了关于构建AI原生团队和产品管理变革的对话，具有一定行业启发性。
